scripts.build: pnpm build:shared && pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @mec/api build && node scripts/with-env.mjs pnpm --filter @mec/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm db:generate && pnpm build:shared && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.db:generate: node scripts/with-env.mjs pnpm --filter @mec/api exec prisma generate
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/with-env.mjs pnpm --filter @mec/api exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: node scripts/with-env.mjs pnpm --filter @mec/api exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: pnpm db:generate && node scripts/with-env.mjs tsx apps/api/prisma/seed.ts
scripts.db:verify: pnpm db:generate && node scripts/with-env.mjs tsx apps/api/prisma/verify.ts
scripts.db:reset: node scripts/with-env.mjs pnpm --filter @mec/api exec prisma migrate reset --force && node scripts/with-env.mjs pnpm db:seed
scripts.db:studio: node scripts/with-env.mjs pnpm --filter @mec/api exec prisma studio
